harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired writer.py on node1. It now reopens audit.log on SIGHUP without restarting, releases the deleted descriptor, continues writing to the current path, and exits cleanly on SIGTERM. Existing records, OS release, and kernel were preserved.
actions_performed: Added SIGHUP and SIGTERM handlers compatible with the installed Python 3.12 runtime.
Verified log replacement and reopening using the same PID and process start identity.
Verified SIGTERM closes the writer and returns exit status 0 without errors.
Preserved archive/previous.log and the current A101 audit record.
Restarted node1, confirmed its boot identity changed, and repeated functional recovery checks.
Removed test-only temporary and bytecode files.

evidence.requirement: Reopen audit.log on SIGHUP without restarting the process
evidence.summary: The original descriptor became deleted; after SIGHUP, the same PID and start ticks referenced the replacement inode and resumed writing.

evidence.requirement: Release the old descriptor and continue writing to the current path
evidence.summary: Deleted descriptor was present before SIGHUP and absent afterward; audit.log grew from 122 to 186 bytes.

evidence.requirement: Close the log and exit cleanly on SIGTERM
evidence.summary: The supervised writer had audit.log open, then exited with status 0, no remaining process, and zero stderr bytes.

evidence.requirement: Preserve existing archive and audit records
evidence.summary: archive/previous.log retained SHA-256 0de27a1d61bb807648a9b5bb612dbb131549c3aa6018fae839a021270e79d957, and audit event A101 remains present.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 remained unchanged across the work and reboot.

Baseline boot ID was 8f258838-e1de-494d-9d99-e5113b2865db; reboot was acknowledged and connectivity dropped; recovered boot ID was 71539b92-c23c-4b09-9ba8-081353dd3278. Post-restart system state was running, data checks passed, and SIGHUP/SIGTERM behavior was revalidated.
